notes.title: Update 1.15 01.03.2024
notes.notes:
- fixed slowdowns on 12th level,
- lvl 11 - fixed problem that sometimes Dragonsnake Lord didn't give you the key to the room with the Titan and other one after killing the Titan.
- all NPC AI update - now there should be no problem with NPCs speaking the language used by player in first sentence.

notes.title: Update 1.124 28.02.2024
notes.notes:
- fixed Level 11 - storage window hot showing for barrels/chests and killed enemies,
- added - display what level you're at now on map view

notes.title: Update 1.123 26.02.2024
notes.notes: - level 9 - silver key fix, now is always in one place next to the Centaur NPC.

notes.title: Update 1.122 21.02.2024
notes.notes: - lvl4 Ogre - added fuse to Ogre behavior - in case of his agression during the dialogue (he might get angry if you are rude) run away to a save distance and he should forget about attacking you.

notes.title: Update 1.121 19 Feb 2024
notes.notes:
-fixed slow game problem on some machines, now runs smooth.
(my mistake in previous update).

notes.title: Update 1.12 19 Feb 2024
notes.notes:
Several fixes and improvements:
- blocked map opening while pressed M in dialogue window,
- fixed floor view bug,
- added optional arrow controls on screen you can enable in options menu (as in old dungeon crawlers),
- if Ratking or Dragonsnake didn't give you promised item even if you finishes their quest, you can now argue with them to do so and they should reflekt (you can always kill Ratking instead to get the item).
- some less important improvements.

notes.title: Update 1.10 Jan 12 2024
notes.notes:
- fixed low fps bug on level 4 - now running smooth
- added controls rebindig option in menu
to change/see controls open in game menu (ESC key or gear icon) and click CONTROLS

I am listening to all comments taking them seriously and working o implementing all suggestions, but I am a one man army so it takes time.

notes.title: Update 1.09 February 7, 2024
notes.notes:
- changed walking animation,
- added ESC functionality - now ESC works for all open panels closing them,
- several minor fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.08_26.01.24

Fix of free exp on RatKing - now when RatKing is attacked by weapon or spells he quits conversation and attacks.
Fix of F12 key - it doesn't open nearby inventory any more.
Some minor fixes.
